id: c4e1b7a2-9d38-45f0-8b6c-1e0a7f3d92aa
description: Detects modprobe/insmod loading the vulnerable openvswitch datapath module, as leveraged by the OVSwrap privilege escalation
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/new-ovswrap-linux-kernel-flaw-lets.html
  - https://kb.wisc.edu/tcd/162952
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/05
tags:
  - attack.t1547.006
  - attack.privilege_escalation
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/modprobe'
      - '/insmod'
      - '/kmod'
    CommandLine|contains: 'openvswitch'
  condition: selection
level: medium
2650.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=modprobe OR Processes.process_name=insmod OR Processes.process_name=kmod) Processes.process="*openvswitch*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2650.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/(modprobe|insmod|kmod)$/i
| regex("openvswitch", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2652.sigma:
title: OVSwrap CVE-2026-64531 Sudoers Modification After Local Root
id: 2b7f9e01-6a4d-4c58-9e3b-7d1c0a8f5e64
description: Detects writes to /etc/sudoers or /etc/sudoers.d by processes outside the sanctioned sudoers editors and package tooling, as performed by the OVSwrap PoC post-exploitation
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/new-ovswrap-linux-kernel-flaw-lets.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/05
tags:
  - attack.t1548.003
  - attack.privilege_escalation
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - '/etc/sudoers'
  filter_legit:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/visudo'
      - '/sudoedit'
      - '/apt'
      - '/dpkg'
      - '/yum'
      - '/dnf'
      - '/rpm'
      - '/cloud-init'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
level: medium
2652.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="/etc/sudoers" OR Filesystem.file_path="/etc/sudoers.d/*") Filesystem.action IN (created,modified,write) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | search process_name!=visudo process_name!=apt process_name!=dpkg process_name!=yum process_name!=dnf process_name!=rpm process_name!=puppet process_name!=chef-client process_name!=cloud-init | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\/etc\/sudoers(\.d\/.+)?$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\/(visudo|sudoedit|apt|apt-get|dpkg|yum|dnf|rpm|puppet|chef-client|cloud-init)$/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2656.sigma:
title: Anonymous POST to Gitea Org-mode Markup Endpoint (CVE-2026-59774)
id: 6f3b2e1a-9c74-4d2b-a1e5-3f0c8b7a91d2
description: Detects unauthenticated POST requests to the Gitea /{owner}/{repo}/markup endpoint, the file-read primitive of CVE-2026-59774 via Org-mode #+INCLUDE absolute-path resolution.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/critical-gitea-flaw-let-unauthenticated.html
  - https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/38642
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/05
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1552.001
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    cs-uri-stem|endswith: '/markup'
  anonymous:
    cs-username: '-'
  condition: selection and anonymous
falsepositives:
  - Authenticated markdown/Org live-preview calls where the proxy strips the username
  - Vulnerability scanners probing the endpoint
level: high
2656.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST Web.url="*/markup" (Web.user="-" OR Web.user="" OR Web.user="anonymous") by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.user, Web.http_method, Web.url, Web.status, Web.http_user_agent
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where status=200
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

2657.sigma:
title: Gitea Server Process Spawning Unexpected Interpreter from Hook Path (CVE-2026-59774 escalation)
id: b21d4c6e-8a17-4f3b-9c02-71e5a9d3f884
description: Detects the Gitea/git server process spawning a shell or network tool whose command line references a hook path, gitea-repositories, /tmp, or /dev/tcp - the token-to-hook command-execution escalation of CVE-2026-59774.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/critical-gitea-flaw-let-unauthenticated.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/08/05
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/gitea'
      - '/git'
    Image|endswith:
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/dash'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
  context:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'hooks/'
      - 'gitea-repositories'
      - '/tmp/'
      - '/dev/tcp'
  condition: selection and context
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate custom Git server-side hooks invoking curl/wget for CI webhooks
  - git-lfs / git-shell helper invocations
level: high
2657.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name=gitea OR Processes.parent_process_name=git) (Processes.process_name=bash OR Processes.process_name=sh OR Processes.process_name=dash OR Processes.process_name=python OR Processes.process_name=python3 OR Processes.process_name=perl OR Processes.process_name=nc OR Processes.process_name=ncat OR Processes.process_name=curl OR Processes.process_name=wget) (Processes.process="*hooks/*" OR Processes.process="*gitea-repositories*" OR Processes.process="*/tmp/*" OR Processes.process="*/dev/tcp*") by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(process, "git-lfs|git-shell|git rev-list|git pack-objects")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
2657.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE @process.name:(bash OR sh OR dash OR python OR python3 OR perl OR nc OR ncat OR curl OR wget) (@process.command_line:(*hooks/* OR *gitea-repositories* OR */tmp/* OR */dev/tcp*)) -@process.command_line:(*git-lfs* OR *git-shell*)
2657.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(gitea|git)$/i
| ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|dash|python3?|perl|nc|ncat|curl|wget)$/i
| regex("(hooks/|gitea-repositories|/tmp/|/dev/tcp)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT regex("(git-lfs|git-shell)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
